name: Crystal Chaser: Tenkuu no Masuishou - R
summary: A special updated version of Crystal Chaser released via Project EGG. The original staff expanded the story from 7 chapters to 9 and updated each one. Many new elements have been added, including a completely new chapter, a full remake of the final chapter, new characters, and "Intermission Theater R," which offers mini-episodes of the characters.
